name: Braid
author: omega
description: Multi-network downloads, from the bar. Braid drives Plexo's engine headlessly (built on Plexo by Anmol Kapil, MIT): combined speed across every connected network, start and control downloads, and optionally send every app's traffic over all links at once.

barWidget.description: Combined download speed over every network. Click for downloads and per-link control.
